stories.title: Man stabs girlfriend, asks, ‘Now will you marry me?’:Boyfriend rants beside body; daughter says ‘cut off the killer’s hands and feet’
stories.summary: ‘My mother has been murdered. She was stabbed in the head and both her ears were cut off. I know him. A call came in Ajit’s name. Mommy said she would be back soon, but she never returned. Ajit killed my mommy. I want him to be stabbed too, his ears, hands and feet cut off. He should be hanged. I want him dead.’ These are the words of Baby’s two devastated daughters in Bulandshahr. On the night of August 11, Baby’s lover, Ajit, allegedly stabbed her 17 times with a knife. The attack was so brutal that her heart was severely damaged. Even after the murder, Ajit allegedly showed no remorse. He remained beside Baby’s body for about an hour, muttering angrily about her refusal to marry him and repeatedly saying, ‘Will you marry me now?’ The incident took place in the Khurja Kotwali area, around 25 km from the district headquarters. First, know what happened Baby (38), originally from Premnagar, Delhi, had been married to Pankaj from Bulandshahr for 15 years. The couple have two sons and two daughters, aged between 8 and 13. They live in Shivlok Colony. The accused, Ajit Thekedar (42), lived in a rented room around 200 metres from their house and worked at a utensil manufacturing factory in Khurja. Ajit’s wife had left him. He and Baby had been in a relationship for around one-and-a-half years. Ajit wanted to marry her, but Baby was unwilling and had gradually distanced herself from him. Police suspect that Ajit, angered by this, planned the murder. Neighbours said they heard loud noises coming from Ajit’s room on Tuesday night and informed the police. Officers arrived shortly afterwards and opened the door, where they found Baby lying on the floor and Ajit sitting beside her. Blood was scattered across the room. Baby was taken to hospital but died on the way. Daughters describe the night After their mother’s death, all four children were inconsolable. The elder daughter said Ajit had called her mother in the evening. ‘When Mummy was leaving, I asked where she was going. Papa had gone to work. Mummy said she would return soon. My elder brother also went with her. After some time, he came back and said Uncle Ajit had sent him back from near the toll booth. Mummy did not return.’ The younger daughter, crying after seeing her mother’s body, said: ‘They stabbed my mommy in the head and cut off both her ears. Stab that man too and cut off his hands, feet and ears. He should die just as my mother died.’ The children said that after their father left for work, all four siblings had stayed with their mother. When Pankaj returned at around 9.30pm, he asked about Baby and repeatedly called her phone. There was no response, and the phone was later switched off. Police arrived some time afterwards and took him with them. Husband: ‘I called her 35-40 times’ Pankaj said he returned from the shop at around 9.30pm and noticed that Baby was missing. The children told him she had gone to buy groceries. ‘I called her 35-40 times, but there was no answer. Her phone was switched off at around 10.30pm. At midnight, policemen came and said an officer wanted to speak to me. When I reached the police station, I learnt that my wife had been murdered.’ Neighbours found blood inside the room Neighbours said Baby had visited Ajit’s room previously as well. On Tuesday night, they heard loud noises coming from the room and became suspicious. Local residents gathered outside and looked inside, where they saw blood spread across the floor. They then alerted the police. Ajit allegedly remained beside the body According to police and neighbours, Ajit was sitting beside Baby’s body with a knife in his hand when officers arrived. He allegedly kept muttering angrily, ‘Will you marry me now?’ No one initially dared to enter the room, prompting the police to intervene. Ajit reportedly did not attempt to flee even after the police arrived. Post-mortem finds 17 deep wounds The post-mortem conducted on Wednesday, August 12, found 17 deep wounds on Baby’s body. Most of the stab wounds were on the left side of her chest and had severely damaged her heart. After the body was handed over to the family, relatives refused to perform the last rites and placed it on the Delhi-Aligarh Highway, blocking traffic. Pankaj said the family wanted immediate action against the accused and demanded that he be killed in an encounter before they would perform the last rites. The highway remained blocked for around an hour. Police teams from four stations and Khurja CO Shobhit Kumar reached the spot. The family agreed to remove the body after the CO assured them of action. Pankaj performed Baby’s last rites at around 5pm on Wednesday. Baby’s sister Parveen said, ‘Just as our sister was killed, we want Ajit’s body to be brought before us in the same condition. We appeal with folded hands to Yogi and Modi ji to have him hanged. Baby’s four young children are suffering. Who will now place a mother’s hand on them? Is there anyone who can give them a mother’s love?’ Accused sent to district jail Khurja CO Shobhit Kumar said- After the post-mortem, the body was handed over to the family. The blockade was cleared after we assured them of action. The accused will receive severe punishment through the court. A case has been registered and the accused has been sent to the district jail.

stories.summary: BJYM workers are protesting in UP on Sunday over the alleged insult to 'Vande Mataram' by Congress. BJP workers protested against Congress in several districts including Varanasi, Lucknow, Prayagraj, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Agra. In Varanasi, more than 100 BJYM workers reached outside the Congress office in Maidagin with torches. Here, they collectively sang 'Vande Mataram'. After this, they raised slogans against top Congress leaders. BJP and Congress workers came face-to-face during the protest. A scuffle broke out between both sides. Seeing the situation, the police stopped Congress leaders inside the office and deployed forces outside. Workers inside the Congress office continued to protest, while BJYM workers continued to raise slogans from outside. After about half an hour of commotion, BJYM workers returned from there. BJYM State President Rohit Mishra said: “The way Vande Mataram is continuously being insulted. It seems that the Congress party has not yet been able to come back from that big ghost of the Muslim League and Jinnah.” View pictures of BJYM's protest Read BJP's accusation against Congress regarding Vande Mataram BJP alleged that the entire Vande Mataram was being sung during the Independence Day programme. After a few initial lines, Sonia started feeling uncomfortable about it. She signaled to stop the song. BJP wrote on X: “Rahul also looked troubled throughout the singing. Meanwhile, Congress has rejected BJP's allegations, stating that Sonia did not try to stop Vande Mataram. She was asking for a chair for Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge.”

stories.title: Father pulls son from Tiger’s jaws:Beats animal with stick for 5-mins; forcing it to flee into the forest
stories.summary: A father confronted a tiger to save his son in Bijnor. The son had gone towards the forest to graze cattle. During this time, the tiger attacked him. The father reached the spot with a stick, hearing the scream. He started beating the tiger with the stick. The tiger tried to scare the father by growling, but he did not step back. Finally, the tiger had to retreat. It ran away into the forest in fear. The son suffered serious injuries to his shoulder and hand in the tiger attack. People took the injured son to the CHC. After primary treatment, the doctors sent him home. The incident occurred on Saturday at 8 am in the Sahanpur range. Now know the complete matter Herder Rafi (33) lives with his family in a makeshift shelter in the Mothla alias Neem Wali forest area. On Saturday, Rafi had gone towards the forest to graze cows and buffaloes. During this time, a tiger lying in ambush attacked Rafi. Rafi started screaming loudly to save himself. His father, Gulam Nabi (65), came running to the spot from their shelter located 250 meters away near the forest area. He saw that the tiger had caught his son Rafi. Gulam Nabi started beating the tiger with a stick, but the tiger was not letting go of Rafi. Gulam Nabi kept raining stick blows on the tiger to save his son. Meanwhile, the tiger also growled at Gulam Nabi several times. The struggle between the tiger and Gulam Nabi continued for about 5 minutes. Finally, the tiger got scared and fled towards the forest. Gulam Nabi's son Rafi was seriously injured in the tiger attack. The tiger had clawed his hand and waist. Seeing blood flowing from his body, Village Head Harvinder Kaur's husband Narvel Singh was immediately informed about the incident. Narvel Singh, who reached the spot, sent Rafi to the CHC. Injured son Rafi said, ''If my father had not been there, my life would not have been saved. He fought with the tiger for about 5 minutes; only then did the tiger flee towards the forest. Meanwhile, upon receiving information, Regional Forest Officer Vikas Kumar and Forest Guard Mohit Kumar reached the spot. They advised the villagers to remain alert.'' Forest Officer Mohit Kumar said - Van Gujjars live in the forest. They have been told many times not to stay here. It is impossible to set up a cage here.

stories.title: IPS officer Ashutosh Mishra’s mother murdered after robbery:Body found at home; there was blood around her mouth
stories.summary: Indravati, the mother of IPS officer Ashutosh Mishra, was murdered after being robbed. Her body was found lying inside the house in Ambedkar Nagar on Sunday afternoon. Gold jewellery was missing from her body, and blood was coming from her mouth. Family members said she was murdered after being robbed. Police sent the body for a post-mortem examination and registered a case of murder and robbery. An investigation is underway. The incident took place in the Malipur police station area. Indravati (95), a resident of Rudha Dhamrua village, has a son, Ashutosh Mishra, who is posted as SP (Headquarters) in Uttar Pradesh Police. After receiving information about the incident, Ashutosh Mishra reached the village from Lucknow. After seeing the condition of the body, family members informed the police. Neck and ear jewelry missing According to family members, Indravati's gold chain, gold beaded Tulsi necklace, nose pin, and ear tops were missing from her neck. The anklets worn on her feet were also not found. Additionally, blood was coming out of her mouth. Based on these circumstances, the family members have expressed suspicion that jewelry was looted after the murder. Police reached the spot and collected evidence Malipur police were informed about the incident around 1 PM on Sunday. The police team reached the spot and inspected the crime scene. After completing the panchnama of the body, it was sent to the district hospital for post-mortem. Police officials have started investigating the evidence and circumstances related to the crime scene. Cause of death will be clear from post-mortem report According to SO Malipur, a case of murder and robbery has been registered based on the information and application from the family members. The police say that the actual cause of death will be clear after the post-mortem report arrives. For now, the police are thoroughly investigating the cause of death, missing jewelry, and all aspects related to the incident.

stories.summary: On the death anniversary of Bharat Ratna and former Prime Minister Pt. Atal Bihari Vajpayee, an Atal Memorial Evening is being organized in Lucknow on Sunday. The program is being organized by the Pt. Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Foundation at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Scientific Convention Center located at KGMU. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath participated in the program as the chief guest. He inaugurated the program by lighting the lamp and released the e-book Atal Vani. Padma Shri and renowned poet-litterateur Prof. Ashok Chakradhar will perform a solo poetry recitation. Earlier on Sunday morning, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath paid floral tributes at the statue of Pt. Atal Bihari Vajpayee located at Lok Bhawan. The Chief Minister recalled Atalji's resolve of Nation First, describing his six-decade-long public life as undisputed and unblemished. He said that Atalji was the Ajatashatru of Indian politics. His nearly six-decade-long public life remained undisputed and unblemished. He always worked with the spirit of 'Nation First'. He was simple and straightforward, but unwavering in his intentions. stories.title: Hindu students dance in burqas:Perform to bhojpuri and bollywood songs; school manager apologises
stories.summary: Hindu girl students performed dances to Bhojpuri and Bollywood songs while wearing burqas, at a school Independence Day program in Gonda. The video surfaced on Sunday evening. In the video, the students can be seen dancing to Bhojpuri songs like 'Choliya Ke Hook Raja Ji' and 'Gulab Jaisan Khilal Badu'. The students were wearing burqas. After the video surfaced, people from both Muslim and Hindu communities protested against it. People demanded action against the school management. After the controversy escalated, the school manager apologized. He said, ''The purpose of the program was only entertainment. If anyone's sentiments have been hurt by this, I apologize.'' The matter is from the Khondare police station area. District Basic Education Officer (BSA) Amit Kumar Singh has ordered an investigation into the matter. Now know the complete matter A program was organized at Knowledge Beam Academy located in Ausani Bujurg at 2 PM on Saturday, on Independence Day. In this, girl students gave performances on different themes. 4-5 Hindu girl students danced wearing burqas in the program. Someone recorded a video of this. The girl students can be seen dancing on stage to Bhojpuri and film songs in the video. The girl students danced to Bhojpuri songs 'Lagai Dihi Choliya Ke Hook Rajaji' and 'Gulab Jaisan Khilal Badu'. Apart from this, they also performed on the Haryanvi song 'Teri Aankh Ka Yo Kajal' and the Bollywood song 'Fevicol'. School manager apologized after video surfaced A controversy erupted after a video of girl students dancing while wearing burqas surfaced. People from both Hindu and Muslim communities protested on social media. Some people called it part of a cultural program, while others objected to it. After the matter escalated, school manager Ram Suresh issued a video apology. He said that the girl students who danced wearing burqas and niqabs are Hindus. The purpose of the program was only entertainment. If anyone's sentiments have been hurt by this, he apologizes for it. BSA orders investigation After the video surfaced, BSA Amit Kumar Singh has ordered an investigation into the matter. He said that if such a program has taken place in the school, a complete investigation will be conducted. Strict action will be taken if found guilty. The school's recognition will also be investigated. Meanwhile, Principal PP Verma informed that the school's recognition is only up to class 8, but teaching is being conducted up to the intermediate level.

stories.title: Dance frenzy over ‘Nishad CM in 2027’ song in Lucknow:Minister Sanjay says ‘I’m just a sentry’ as show of strength unfolds before Dayashankar Singh
stories.summary: In Lucknow on Sunday, Minister Sanjay Nishad demonstrated his strength. The occasion was the 11th Foundation Day of his party, Nishad Party (Nirbal Indian Shoshit Hamara Aam Dal). Workers, holding Nishad Party flags and wearing caps, chanted slogans of 'Dr. Sanjay Nishad Zindabad'. They danced to the song 'Sanjay Nishad CM in 27...'. Transport Minister and BJP leader Dayashankar Singh was also present on the stage. Sanjay Nishad said, "Earlier we were on the streets, but today we are in the Assembly. We are raising the voice of our people. People have gathered here on the issue of reservation, and the Nishad Party will not compromise on the matter of reservation." He said- I am not a minister, but a guard. The real ministers are these people (workers). We work to raise their voices and rights in the Assembly. The event took place at 4 PM at Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Law University in Ashiana. Workers from across the state had arrived for the event. See 4 pictures Minister said the fisherman community needs the right to participate in power Sanjay Nishad said, "Those who ask us for an account of seven and a half years should first give an account of 70 years. People from our backward community have played an important role in liberating the country. The people gathered here are the ones who overthrew the Mughals and brought people to power. Now this very community will reach power itself." He said that workers from every sector and district of the state have reached here. These people will solve their problems by pressing a button in 2027. He said that where the youth goes, the world follows. “The fisherman community needs the right to participate in power,” he said. Sanjay Nishad told Minister Dayashankar: “You talk to the BJP leadership” Sanjay Nishad told Minister Dayashankar Singh: “You are listening to the voice of the community on the issue of reservation. We would like to urge you to talk to the top leadership of the Bharatiya Janata Party on the issue of reservation as soon as possible and take concrete steps to implement it. Let it not happen that delay in decision-making affects the interests of the society.” District presidents were entrusted with the responsibility of bringing workers Drums and trumpets played at the main entrance of the event venue. Workers gathered from the main road to the event venue. This is also being considered as a show of strength by the Nishad Party before the 2027 UP Assembly elections. Before the programme, the party had assigned the responsibility of bringing workers from different districts to all district presidents and office bearers. Discussion on strengthening the party During the programme, there was a discussion on strengthening the party in 403 assembly constituencies across 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh. Special emphasis was placed on those seats where the party's hold is weak. According to information received from the party, office bearers whose contribution will be crucial in making the programme successful will be assigned important responsibilities in the upcoming elections.

stories.title: Lucknow woman electrocuted by high-voltage line while drying clothes:Burned for 5 minutes; was unconscious and dangled from roof ledge
stories.summary: In Lucknow, on Sunday morning at 9 AM, a woman came in contact with a high-voltage power line. She remained stuck to the wire on the balcony of her house for about 5 minutes. Her clothes caught fire due to the electric shock. Smoke kept emanating from her body. The woman continuously writhed in pain. Seeing the woman stuck to the wire, people nearby called the power house. The electricity supply was shut off. After this, the woman was separated from the wire and taken to the hospital with the help of an ambulance. The woman's condition remains critical. The incident occurred in the Sarojini Nagar area. She was alone at home, had gone to dry clothes Sandeep Rawat, who lives in Jairajpuri Colony of Sarojininagar, works installing Wi-Fi in homes. His wife Meera (35) and younger brother Pradeep Rawat live with him. On Sunday morning, Sandeep was sleeping at home. Pradeep had gone to Ujjain on Saturday for Mahakal darshan. Around 9 AM, after washing clothes, Meera went to the second-floor terrace to dry them. While hanging the clothes, her dupatta touched the 11,000-volt high-tension line passing nearby. As soon as she was electrocuted, Meera fell onto the ledge outside the boundary. During this, her leg also touched the wire. After this, smoke started coming out of Meera's body and she began to burn. First taken to Sarojininagar CHC, then referred from there When people nearby saw Meera stuck to the wire, they raised an alarm. Hearing the noise, her husband Sandeep woke up. Seeing the scene outside, he panicked. People immediately called Gahru Power House and had the electricity supply cut off. By then, Meera was severely burnt. She was brought down after the power was turned off. She was taken to Sarojininagar Community Health Center (CHC) by ambulance. Here, after first aid, doctors referred her to Civil Hospital. Currently, she is undergoing treatment at Civil Hospital, where her condition remains critical. Laborer dies due to electrocution in Mohanlalganj In Jyotinagar, Mohanlalganj, a labourer was electrocuted while working on a house under construction on Sunday morning. He was severely burnt in the accident. He was immediately taken to CHC Mohanlalganj, where doctors declared him dead. Mohammad Arman, a resident of Jyotinagar, had taken Manoj (22) from Mazdoor Chauraha on daily wages to work at his under-construction house in the morning. During work, Manoj came into contact with electric wires. He was severely burnt due to the electric shock. Upon receiving information, Mohanlalganj police reached the spot. The police took the body into custody and sent it for post-mortem. The deceased was identified as Manoj, a resident of Ranikheda, Majra Bairisalpur. The police have informed his family about the incident.

stories.title: Woman doctor found dead in Meerut clinic:Married seven months ago; had been living with parents after marital dispute
stories.summary: The body of a 26-year-old female doctor was found in her clinic on Sunday morning in Meerut. Family members stated that their daughter was murdered. Both the deceased's hands were reportedly tied when the body was found. Dr. Khushali had been running a clinic at the Ayurveda and Natural Center in Pallavpuram Phase-2 for about four months. On Sunday morning around 6:15 AM, she left her parental home for the clinic. Clinic staff found her body in the room a short while later. They immediately informed the family. Following this, her family and the police arrived at the scene. Police have obtained the clinic's CCTV footage and are investigating. After marriage, she had a dispute with her husband and then started living at her parental home. Dr. Khushhali (26) of Pallavpuram was married to Mayank Chaudhary, a resident of TP Nagar, on January 14, 2026. Soon after the marriage, disputes began between the husband and wife. Following this, Khushhali had been living at her parental home for some time. The husband's family lives in the TP Nagar area. Khushhali's father is a Sub-Inspector in BSF and is currently posted in Delhi. Khushhali's cousin Akhil alleged that when Khushhali's body was found, both her hands were tied. Family members have raised questions about the death. However, the police have not yet officially confirmed that her hands were tied. CCTV will unravel the mystery of the incident Police have seized the footage from CCTV cameras installed outside the clinic. The footage is being examined to see who all came to the clinic after Khushali arrived and for how long they stayed. Police are also interrogating the clinic staff and family members. Additionally, forensic examination of the evidence found at the crime scene is being conducted. Police are currently investigating both murder and suicide. Police state that the actual cause of death will only become clear based on the post-mortem report, forensic examination, and evidence found at the crime scene.

stories.title: Chaos at 16-minute sale in Kanpur:Stampede breaks out, cloth trader shuts shop and flees; police use batons to disperse crowd
stories.summary: A commotion broke out in Kanpur due to a strange offer by a textile businessman. The businessman announced that on his birthday, any clothing item would be sold for 16 rupees in 16 minutes. After the offer, a crowd of about two and a half thousand people gathered at the shop. Seeing the crowd, the shopkeeper closed his shop and fled. People started creating a ruckus. Police arrived at the scene and dispersed the crowd, leading to a stampede-like situation. The entire incident took place around 12 AM on Sunday midnight at Alam Market. Police have registered a case against Mohammad Alam, Raees Alam, and Salman Alam at Anwarganj police station. See 2 pictures Got videos made by influencers, promised to give clothes for ₹16 Raees Alam has a clothing showroom named Alam Mart in Alam Market. August 16 is his birthday. He had videos made by influencers for his birthday. After that, he uploaded them on Facebook and Instagram. In it, the anchor is saying that for Kanpur residents, from the night of August 15, men's wear will be available for 16 rupees in 16 minutes. Textile merchant Raees Alam said, “This is Alam Bhai's birthday. We have millions of lovers and this is their wish. That will be our love for them. We will definitely fulfil it. Just like Salman Bhai's commitment that 'once he has said it, he doesn't even listen to himself.' Similarly, if Alam Bhai has also said it, then Insha'Allah (God willing), everyone will be heard.” He had said the offer will create a stir in the whole city In the second video, Raees Alam said, “This time the offer will create a complete stir. Fill your bag on the 16th. The offer will be applicable at 11:59 PM on the night of August 15th. It will close at 12:15 AM. It will include jeans, shoes, t-shirts, glasses, everything. We are taking 16 rupees, but this will be a return gift from my brother.” Seeing the offer on social media, people started gathering outside the shop. Around 11:30 PM, more than 2,500 people had gathered. Crowd gathered as soon as they heard about the 16 rupee sale Seeing the crowd at the shop, shopkeeper Raees Alam pulled down the showroom's shutter. Seeing this, the crowd started creating a ruckus. A traffic jam situation developed nearby. The traffic system started to get disrupted. Upon receiving information, ACP Anwarganj Manjay Singh along with the police force from the station reached the spot and tried to disperse the people. Late at night, the police announced through a microphone that people should go to their respective homes. “Do not gather unnecessarily. If you do not move, strict action will be taken. You are not moving even after being told many times,” Manjay Singh said. After this, the police had to use mild force, which led to a stampede. People started running helter-skelter. During this, many people fell on top of each other. Many people's slippers were also left behind at the spot. ACP Anwarganj Manjay Singh said: An offer was given on social media by Raees Alam, the shopkeeper of Alam Mart in Alam Market, to buy any clothing item for 16 rupees in 16 minutes, which led to a crowd gathering outside the shop. The police reached the spot, dispersed the crowd, registered a case against the shopkeeper, and one accused has been taken into custody for questioning.

stories.title: Man dies after Chinese 'manjha' slices neck:Gets killed while riding pillion on Ghaziabad highway
stories.summary: A young man died after his neck being cut by a Chinese manjha in Ghaziabad. He was riding a bike on Saturday at 6 pm when suddenly Chinese manjha got entangled in his throat. Due to the high speed of the bike, his neck was severed. Blood spread on the road. According to police, the young man had left from Noida on a bike with his friend. Both were going to Ghazipur in Delhi. The accident occurred on the way near the Kaushambi police station area on National Highway-9. The manjha was so sharp that it cut through the bone of the young man's neck, causing his neck to hang loose. The friend sitting behind somehow managed to control the bike and screamed for help from people nearby. After this, he tied the young man's throat with a towel. Police arrived on information from passersby and immediately took the injured young man to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. 3 pictures of the accident- Now sequentially understand the entire matter- Now read about 5 major incidents caused by Chinese manjha... Since when has Chinese manja been banned in UP? Why is it dangerous? How is Chinese manja made, what is the punishment provision for making and selling it? In which states is Chinese manja banned? In India, the sale, storage, and use of Chinese manja have been banned in several states and union territories. This ban has been implemented primarily keeping in mind human and animal safety, environmental protection, and public health. Chinese manja has been banned in Delhi since 2017 as well. Despite that, it is sold openly.

stories.title: Dumper runs over mother-son, 3 others, killing 2:Were shopping at a Mathura store; 6-year-old girl was heading home with toffee
stories.summary: A speeding dumper ran over a 20-year-old man, his mother and a six-year-old girl in Mathura on Sunday (16 Aug) morning, killing the young man and child on the spot. The man's mother suffered serious injuries and remains in critical condition. The accident occurred around 8am in the Sadar Bazaar police station area, about 3km from the district headquarters. Three hit while near market shop The young man had gone to the market on a motorcycle with his mother and was standing near a shop when the dumper suddenly hit them. At the same time, the six-year-old girl had bought a toffee from the shop and was returning home when she was struck by the speeding vehicle. Dumper driver flees after accident The impact killed the youth and girl on the spot. The dumper driver abandoned the vehicle and fled before police arrived. Local residents rushed to the scene and shifted the injured woman to the Military Hospital by ambulance. Doctors said her condition remained critical. Road blocked after deaths Angry over the accident, local residents blocked the road, leading to a traffic jam. Police reached the spot, spoke to the crowd and managed to clear the road after counselling them. Police sent the bodies of the deceased for post-mortem and seized the dumper for further investigation. See the pictures Know the complete matter According to eyewitnesses, Geeta Devi, 40, a resident of Shri Ji Colony in Aurangabad, had gone shopping with her 20-year-old son Prashant on a motorcycle. Prashant parked the motorcycle outside a grocery shop at around 8am and began speaking to the shopkeeper. Geeta was seated on the motorcycle. Child had stopped to buy a toffee Around the same time, six-year-old Ayra, daughter of local resident Imran, came to the shop to buy a toffee. After making the purchase, she was returning from the shop when the speeding dumper approached. Dumper hits mother-son before child Eyewitnesses said, “The dumper first struck Prashant and his mother while they were near the motorcycle. It then hit Ayra and continued ahead.” The impact resulted in the deaths of Prashant and Ayra, while Geeta suffered serious injuries. Man and child died on impact As soon as the collision occurred, the mother and son sitting on the bike fell onto the road. Meanwhile, Ayra came under the wheels of the dumper. Hearing the screams, people ran to save them. By then, the driver had abandoned the dumper and fled. People saw that Prashant, his mother Geeta Devi, and Ayra were all drenched in blood. Prashant and Ayra had died on the spot, while Geeta Devi was unconscious. People immediately rushed her to the Military Hospital. Doctors admitted her and started treatment. Her condition remains critical. People blocked the road As soon as information about the incident was received, a crowd of people gathered at the spot. Angry people blocked the road. Upon receiving information, family members and police also reached the spot. The police gathered information about the incident from people and checked CCTV cameras of nearby shops. Family members demanded action against the accused driver. The police seized the dumper and assured action. After this, people removed the blockade. The police are searching for the accused driver.

stories.title: Firing at Varanasi Airport, 2 employees injured:Shiv Sena leader’s pistol accidentally fires while checking it; was travelling to Mumbai
stories.summary: A passenger accidentally fired a gun during a weapon check at Varanasi airport on Sunday morning, injuring two employees, including a woman. Both were taken to New Lakshmi Trauma Centre for treatment. The incident took place at around 9.30 am. The passenger, Kamlesh Rai, was travelling to Mumbai with his wife on Air India Express flight IX-1810. He had already declared the firearm he intended to carry on the flight. During the weapon inspection, the gun accidentally fired a round. After being alerted by the airport authorities, police reached the spot and recovered a pistol and 21 cartridges from Kamlesh. After questioning him for around five hours, Phulpur police took him to the police station. Kamlesh, a native of Azamgarh, is a Shiv Sena leader and a former councillor in Mumbai. His social media profiles feature photographs with Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde and Dhananjay Singh. Passenger had declared licensed pistol before airport inspection Kamlesh Rai had informed airport authorities in advance that he was carrying a licensed pistol, according to Puneet Gupta, director of Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport in Varanasi. Rai was scheduled to travel to Mumbai with his wife on an Air India Express flight at 11.30 am. During the mandatory weapon inspection, the pistol accidentally discharged one round. Bullet hits woman staffer after striking floor According to airport authorities, the bullet first hit the floor before striking Suman, 32, a woman employee from Bihar, in the thigh. Another employee, Rohit Raj, was injured in the hand by bullet fragments. Both suffered bleeding injuries and were immediately taken to hospital, where they are undergoing treatment. Airport was under high alert for Independence Day The airport had been placed under a high-alert zone from August 11 to 20 in view of Independence Day security arrangements. The firing nevertheless triggered panic at the airport. Police officials, including the ADCP of Gomti Zone, along with intelligence personnel, reached the spot and began investigating the incident. Kamlesh Rai is former Mumbai corporator, runs college in Azamgarh Kamlesh Rai, a resident of the Jiyanpur police station area in Azamgarh, has previously served as a corporator in Mumbai. His son is currently a sitting corporator in Mumbai, while his mother is a village head. Rai is also known to travel with two bodyguards. Runs postgraduate college in Azamgarh Rai manages Babu Shiv Patthar Rai Postgraduate College in Azamgarh. He is associated with the management of the institution and is involved in its operations. Injured staffer says passenger's pistol fired during security check Airport security scanner staffer Rohit said, “I went with my colleague Suman to the counter for the X-ray inspection of the passenger's weapon.” According to him, “The passenger took out his pistol, which already had a round loaded. During the inspection, the trigger was pressed and the weapon fired.” Bullet hit Suman, splinters injured Rohit Rohit said, “Suman was standing directly in front of the passenger when the pistol discharged, causing the bullet to hit her leg.” Rohit suffered injuries from bullet fragments. He said, “I could not determine whether the trigger was pressed deliberately or accidentally.” DCP says firing occurred accidentally during standard check DCP Gomti Neetu Kadyan said, “Phulpur police and other officials inspected the spot after the incident.” She said, “Kamlesh's licensed pistol has an all-India permit and it was being checked as part of the standard procedure before boarding.” He added, “The firing occurred accidentally during the inspection. Two ground staff employees sustained injuries.” Similar airport firing incident reported in Mumbai in 2010 A similar accidental firing incident was reported at Mumbai airport in September 2010 during the inspection of a passenger's licensed pistol. Indore-bound passenger Govind Patidar was undergoing a weapon check when the pistol suddenly discharged. The bullet struck the floor, sending a piece of tile flying into the leg of a woman screening employee, Reena Roy, who suffered minor injuries. Passenger detained after accidental firing Patidar had a valid licence for the weapon and was taken into custody by police following the incident. According to reports, the pistol's magazine contained seven rounds. Patidar was reportedly checking whether the weapon was unloaded when it discharged during the inspection.

stories.title: Speeding car flips, kills two uncles and nephew:Travelling at 100 kmph from Noida to Unnao; car overturns after sudden braking
stories.summary: Three members of the same family, including a nephew and his two maternal uncles, were killed in a horrific road accident in Uttar Pradesh's Hathras early today (16 Aug). Four others, including a two-and-a-half-year-old child, sustained serious injuries after their car overturned several times on the Aligarh-Etah Highway. The family of seven was travelling from Noida to Unnao in a Honda Brio when the accident occurred around 2.50am in the Sikandararao Kotwali area, about 40km from the district headquarters. Car overturned repeatedly while trying to avoid collision According to eyewitnesses, another car suddenly appeared in front of the Brio, forcing the driver to apply the brakes abruptly. The vehicle, which was reportedly travelling at nearly 100kmph, lost control while trying to avoid a car parked on the roadside. The car overturned four to five times before skidding nearly 20 metres and coming to a halt. Three killed, toddler among injured The deceased have been identified as Ramji (26) and his maternal uncles Jagat Pal (50) and Avdhesh (35), all originally from Hardoi. The injured include Ramji's brother-in-law Rajeev Pal (30), his sister Goldie (28), his two-and-a-half-year-old nephew Naksh, and relative Maya (40), all residents of Unnao. They were admitted to hospital for treatment. See pictures of the accident- Read the entire matter sequentially Injured brother-in-law recalls Hathras crash: ‘I woke up to a loud bang’ Rajiv Pal, the injured brother-in-law of deceased Ramji, said the family originally belongs to Balamau in Hardoi and currently lives in a rented house in Ek Murti, Noida. The family works in car washing. According to Rajiv, seven family members left Noida around 11pm on Saturday (15 Aug) in a Honda Brio to attend a function at a relative's house in Unnao. They had travelled around 185km and reached Hathras when the accident occurred. ‘Everyone was sleeping when I suddenly heard a loud bang’ Rajiv said Ramji was driving the car while the other passengers were asleep. He said, “Around 2.50am, I suddenly woke up after hearing a loud bang. I saw that the car had overturned and was skidding along the road. The family members sitting in the rear were badly injured.” He added, “My son, who was sitting on my lap, was also hurt. There was screaming and panic inside the car.” Passers-by rescued those trapped inside The Honda Brio was severely damaged in the crash, with its bonnet and headlights almost completely destroyed. Passers-by stopped and helped pull the trapped passengers out of the wreckage. Police took all the injured to Hathras District Hospital, where doctors declared three people dead. The remaining four, including Rajiv and his young son, are undergoing treatment. My brother had bought a second hand car Ramji's younger brother Shyamji said, “We received information about the accident from the police at night, so we reached the spot in the morning. My younger brother Ramji had bought a second-hand Honda Brio car with a Noida number just a few months ago.” Shyamji said, “Uncle Jagatpal, Avdhesh and my brother Ramji were residents of Balamau in Hardoi. While my brother-in-law Rajiv and his family are residents of Bangarmau in Unnao.” Sikandarrau Kotwali in-charge Shiv Kumar Sharma said, “Three people from the same family died due to the car overturning, while four people were injured. The deceased are from Hardoi and all the injured are residents of Unnao. The bodies have been sent for post-mortem. The car has been seized. The accident is being investigated.”

stories.title: 'Team India selection not in my hands' says Bhuvneshwar Kumar:RCB pacer took 45 wickets in last 2 IPL seasons
stories.summary: The UP T20 League has started at Ekana Stadium in Lucknow. Indian fast bowler and captain of Lucknow Falcons Bhuvneshwar Kumar said that he respects R Ashwin's opinion after the former cricketer had backed his selection for the 2027 World Cup. The right-arm pacer had a great IPL 2026 season, taking 28 wickets in 16 matches and helping the Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) win back-to-back titles. Bhuvneshwar said that this time the Lucknow team will play completely united and will work hard to win the trophy. The league being held at two venues will increase audience engagement and fan base. Dainik Bhaskar had a special conversation with Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Read the full interview Question: Your IPL season has been consistently good. Are you y for the new domestic season and the UP T20 League? Answer: Absolutely ready, because I believe the domestic season starts with the UPT20 League. So, full preparations are underway. My preparations are ongoing, as are the team's, and I hope this season goes well. We are working towards this. The team has been balanced. New players have also joined the team, so that good results can be delivered in the match. Question: Sunil Gavaskar made his team for the World Cup. R Ashwin advocated for your place in it, what would you like to say? Answer: Look, I have nothing to say about other people's opinions. I'm sure it's their opinion; I respect it. But my job is to play cricket, to try and perform, and I am doing that. That's all I can say. Our focus is entirely on playing cricket. What happens after that, the team management and administration have to decide. Question: How do you view the four seasons of the UP T20 League? Answer: The seasons have been very good. I hope this season will also be just as good for all the players, because as I mentioned before, it's an opportunity for everyone. The new boys who come, they come with hard work, so I think everyone is moving a step forward and providing opportunities, so it will be the same this year. Question : What would you say about the new team formed in Lucknow? Answer: In the last two seasons, our team's performance was not as expected and we missed out on the trophy. This time, we identified our shortcomings in the auction and built a balanced team. Speaking about individual performance, he said that IPL experience will come in handy, but T20 cricket is a game of 11 players. We will create a positive environment and aim to win the title this time. Question: How will you increase the fan base of UP T20 League? Answer: Praising the Uttar Pradesh Cricket Association (UPCA), it was said that organizing matches at two venues will increase fan engagement. Excellent work is being done for the development of cricket in the state, and this league will give the country many star cricketers in the future. With new venues and new teams, both player connections and the fan base will increase. Question: What would you say about the talent hunt program conducted by UPCA? Answer: This talent hunt program, started by UPCA, will definitely provide an opportunity to children from rural backgrounds who are currently far from the mainstream of cricket despite having good talent. In such a situation, the children who are found now will focus only on speed, but when they join such leagues, the quality of their bowling will improve. Variation will come.

stories.title: 'Will reduce the venom enough to cause high, not death':Snakebite high sold for ₹70,000; supplied to clubs on demand
stories.summary: Famous YouTuber Elvish Yadav was accused of using snake venom for intoxication at parties in Noida. The question arose: Is snake bite intoxication being used in UP? If yes, why are people turning to this deadly addiction? How big is its network? Dainik Bhaskar started an investigation to expose this drug trade and growing trend. Our reporters visited several clubs in Noida and Delhi-NCR. They befriended drug users. We received input that snake bite parties are increasing in Delhi-NCR, with youth from UP also attending. Sources revealed that such parties are held in some clubs in Noida and the South Delhi area of Hauz Khas. We went there and befriended a dancer. The dancer explained the entire network of snake bite intoxication at these parties. He said that this drug is something else. All other drugs in the world fail in comparison. After a few days of conversation, he introduced us to Shahrukh, who was outside the club. Shahrukh is a peddler and also supplies snakes for snake bites. He made several shocking revelations to us about this network. Reporter: I need a snake bite, some friends have come from Canada. Shahrukh: You won't find this here. It's a drug for the rich and it's also banned. If the police find out, we'll be jailed. Reporter: Arrange it from somewhere, we'll give you whatever money you ask for. Shahrukh: Okay, I'll talk tonight. A guy comes by 1 AM, he brings the drug supplies. Reporter: When will you tell me? Shahrukh: I will tell you by 2 AM tonight. The next morning, Shahrukh called on WhatsApp. He informed that there is a settlement of snake charmers in Sonipat, Haryana, from where snakes are supplied to clubs in UP. He provided the name and address of the supplier, Karan Nath. 4 days later, we reached that settlement in Sonipat. To conceal our identity, we took a local female colleague with us. Being strangers, the suppliers were avoiding talking to us. It took 4 days to win their trust. Finally, we met Karan Nath, the snake supplier, and his associate in a mud house. Reporter: Brother, can we get snakes? Karan Nath: Yes, you can get them. What for? Reporter: Some friends have come from abroad. They want to get high on snake venom. Karan Nath: Which snake do you need? Reporter: Can I get cobra, krait, and sand boa? Second Supplier: Will you take all of them? Reporter: Yes, we'll buy all of them. Karan Nath: Okay, give me some time. I'll talk and let you know. After waiting for about an hour, we met both suppliers again at a nearby restaurant. The conversation here made it clear that the links of this network are spread across many people. Reporter: We need the snakes in Noida. Can you bring them in your car? Karan Nath: Yes, we'll come in our own car. Reporter : Will smaller snakes also be available, those with less venom? Karan Nath : Yes, but for that, we'll have to go to the jungle. It will take some time. Reporter : Can you provide venom from a poisonous snake, but diluted? Karan Nath : Yes, it will take 2-3 days. We will reduce the venom according to the desired intoxication. Reporter : Something that causes intoxication but not death? Karan Nath : Yes, I understand. Reporter : Where have you supplied before? Karan Nath : People take it to Ujjain, Mandi, Kasaul, and even Chandigarh. Reporter : How long will it take for 16 hours of intoxication? Karan Nath : We'll do it in 2 days. Reporter : How much will you charge for 5 people? Karan Nath : 70 thousand rupees. Give 30 thousand as advance first. Reporter : Make it 50 thousand. Karan Nath: No, it won't be less than 70 thousand. We have taken up to 1.5 to 2 lakh rupees from other people. Reporter: First show the snake, we will give an advance after we like it. Karan Nath: Okay. After this, Karan showed us the snake. We recorded its visuals with a hidden camera. After that, we refused to make a deal by making an excuse. Our aim was to expose the entire network of snake venom intoxication, the important links of which had come before us. The investigation revealed that this intoxication is done on-demand. That is, drug users in clubs and private parties call the supplier and get bitten by a snake. Due to this, we could not directly reach the drug users in these parties. It's deadly, yet why the addiction to snake bites? A snake bite causes dizziness, deep lethargy, or unconsciousness. This is the effect of its venom. It is different from all other types of intoxication. This effect can last for up to 24 hours, whereas other intoxicants wear off in a few hours. That's why some young people are attracted to it. But, it is extremely dangerous. The effect of the venom can paralyze the body. It can also lead to death. Now, learn how to reduce snake venom Poisonous snakes like cobras have so much venom that if they bite, death occurs within 12 to 24 hours. Supplier Karan said that they extract 90% of the cobra's venom. After that, if it bites, there will be deep lethargy for 6-7 hours, but no death. To reduce the venom, the snake's mouth is held and it is made to bite into a box. When the snake bites the box, it releases venom. If a cobra bites 8-10 times continuously, the venom is exhausted.

stories.title: Two women con artists trap cops in Gorakhpur:Blackmails DSP, dupe doctors of ₹10 crore; diary says, 'Will become a billionaire soon'
stories.summary: The story of two female fraudsters from Gorakhpur is startling. On one side is Anshika Singh, who allegedly lured people with her looks and sweet talk. Even police officers reportedly fell into her trap and became victims of blackmail. On the other is Garima Singh, who dreamed of becoming a billionaire and allegedly defrauded doctors and officers of around ₹10 crore. She was preparing to buy a ₹1 crore Defender, but her alleged fraud came to light before she could do so. Although Anshika Singh and Garima Singh used different methods, their alleged modus operandi had striking similarities. Both are currently lodged in Gorakhpur jail. How did educated and influential people fall into their trap? What methods did they use? Read the complete story… First, know the story of Anshika Singh Anshika used to strip during WhatsApp video calls On January 20, 2026, Anshika Singh alias Antima was celebrating her birthday with friends near a model shop in Gorakhpur's Singhariya area. She later got into an argument with the manager of a private hospital and allegedly pointed a pistol at him. During the ensuing scuffle, a bullet struck the manager's friend in the stomach. People at the scene caught Anshika and her companions, following which police arrested them and sent them to jail. During the investigation, police uncovered details of Anshika's alleged activities. According to investigators, she would strip during WhatsApp video calls and secretly record the person on the other end. Several such videos were recovered from her mobile phone. During questioning, police said she admitted that she would lure people to fulfil her lifestyle demands, make video calls while undressed and record them. She would then allegedly use the recordings to extort money. Police claim Anshika trapped around 150 people through video calls over five years. The alleged victims included more than 15 police officers, including a DSP from Ayodhya and the in-charge of GIDA police station. Now read about 4 major scams of fraudster Anshika 1. Filed rape case against Deoria youth and extorted lakhs According to the police investigation, Anshika first allegedly trapped Raj Vishwakarma, a resident of Sopara in Deoria, in 2021. She filed a rape and intimidation case against him and allegedly extorted lakhs of rupees in the name of a settlement. In 2023, she began living in a rented house in the Kotwali Khalilabad area of Sant Kabir Nagar. 2. Extorted ₹50,000 from Sant Kabir Nagar youth Police said Anshika similarly trapped Suraj Singh, a resident of Khalilabad. When he allegedly refused to pay, she filed a rape case against him. She also allegedly extorted ₹50,000 from another Khalilabad resident, Priyanshu Singh, by threatening to implicate him in a false case. Priyanshu had also lodged a complaint through the CM portal. 3. Demanded ₹2 lakh from landlord City SP Abhinav Tyagi said Anshika was living on rent in the Kotwali area of Sant Kabir Nagar in 2021. Her landlady, Gudiya Peter, complained to the SP that Anshika was bringing men to the rented room, allegedly causing embarrassment in the neighbourhood. When asked to vacate the property, Anshika allegedly demanded ₹2 lakh and threatened to implicate the family in a false case. Fearing her threats, the landlady installed CCTV cameras at the house. Anshika vacated the property a few days later. She had also made a reel in front of the police jeep outside Sant Kabir Nagar Kotwali, using an objectionable song. 4. Fled with rented Thar and went underground Cantt CO Yogendra Kumar Singh said a case was registered on October 12, 2025, against Anshika and six associates for allegedly stealing a Thar and using fake number plates. The investigation found that Anshika had travelled to Delhi with friends in September 2025, where they allegedly rented a Thar and then absconded with it. She reportedly continued moving around the city using fake number plates to evade arrest. On October 13, police arrested two accused, Priya Pravas Dubey alias Vikki and Aakash Verma alias Bunty and sent them to jail. After learning of their arrests, Anshika allegedly went underground. Police recovered four fake number plates from the vehicle, two from Haryana, one from Bihar and one from Gorakhpur. Now know the story of fraudster Garima Singh Garima allegedly defrauded doctors and officers in the name of loans A recent case involving Garima Singh came to light in Gorakhpur on August 13. Dr Paramatma Singh, 45, allegedly died by suicide after jumping from the eighth floor of an apartment. Police found a one-page suicide note in his pocket, in which he held Garima responsible for his death. According to police, Garima had allegedly defrauded the doctor of ₹1.40 crore, leaving him under severe financial and emotional stress. 10 complaints against Garima, five FIRs registered Five FIRs have so far been registered against Garima, her railway-officer father and her husband, teacher Bhanu Pratap Singh, over allegations of defrauding doctors and government officials. The fifth FIR against Garima and her alleged associates was registered at Gorakhnath police station on July 13. It followed the death of the doctor, whose suicide note allegedly named Garima and her associates as responsible. According to police, the father-daughter duo, son-in-law and other members of the alleged gang are accused of fraud worth more than ₹10 crore. Police have received complaints from 10 victims so far. FIRs have been registered in five cases — three at AIIMS police station, one at Sahjanwa and one at Gorakhnath police station. Complaints from six other alleged victims are being investigated at CO level. Police said FIRs will be registered in these cases if sufficient evidence emerges. Sahjanwa Railway Station Superintendent Dhruv Narayan Singh, 55, allegedly helped his daughter Garima, 29, target employees and officers in his department. Police said the duo primarily used two methods. First method — targeting people seeking loans Garima allegedly approached people who needed loans and told them to take the loan while she would pay the instalments. She would reportedly give the borrower 10–20% of the sanctioned amount and have the remaining money transferred to her bank account. Initially, she would pay some instalments herself to gain their confidence before cutting off contact. Second method — targeting existing borrowers Garima also allegedly targeted people who already had loans but were struggling to repay their instalments. Gorakhpur Junction Station Superintendent Satya Prakash Singh was allegedly approached in this manner. According to him, Garima promised to have his existing loan settled quickly, but told him he would first need to take a new personal loan and transfer the money to her account. She allegedly promised to pay the monthly instalments. Satya Prakash said Garima took his documents and arranged loans totalling ₹1.67 crore from six banks — ICICI, HDFC, Yes Bank, State Bank, SMFG and Bandhan Bank. She also transferred around ₹10 lakh to his account, telling him it was his profit. Fraudster's diary said, 'I will become a billionaire' Police recovered a diary allegedly belonging to Garima. It contained a handwritten goal stating: ‘I, Garima Singh, will become a billionaire by April 2026.’ The diary further stated that she planned to clear all her loans between April and May and aimed to earn ₹100 crore during that period. It ended with the statement: 'Garima Singh is a crorepati. Thank you, God.'

stories.title: Can Azam Khan contest 2027 elections?:Shivpal claims he will become Home Minister; how strong is the claim? Know the political equation
stories.summary: On August 12, after meeting Azam Khan in Rampur jail, Shivpal Yadav said - If the SP government is formed in 2027, Azam Khan will be made the Home Minister. He claimed that Azam Khan has been subjected to great injustice. He is being made to lie on the floor in jail. Medicines and even clothes are not being provided. Not a single facility meant for MLAs is being given. He is in great pain. Azam Khan has been sentenced to 2 to 10 years in 8 cases. According to Section 8 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, upon conviction, the membership of MPs and MLAs can be terminated. Moreover, they cannot contest any election for 6 years after completing their sentence. Azam Khan is currently in jail in the double PAN card case. His bail application is pending in the High Court. The question is, how much weight does Shivpal Yadav's claim of making him Home Minister carry? Can Azam Khan contest the 2027 assembly elections? Why is Azam Khan so important for SP? What's the hitch in getting out of jail More than 100 cases are registered against Azam Khan. According to his lawyer Imranullah, he has either received bail or been acquitted in all cases except the double PAN card case. Azam is currently in jail after the court's sentencing in the double PAN card case. He has appealed to the High Court for bail. The hearing was on August 6, but Justice Vikram D. Chauhan recused himself from the case due to personal reasons. Now a new bench has been formed. The hearing was postponed on August 14. It will be decided on the next date whether he will get bail or have to go to the Supreme Court. What happened when in the dual PAN card case? Will Azam be able to contest elections solely based on bail? Advocate Imranullah, who is representing Azam Khan's case, claims that bail can be granted after the case is presented before the new bench of the High Court. This means, Azam's path to coming out before the 2027 assembly elections could be clear. But, the important question is, can Azam Khan also contest elections? On this, High Court senior advocate Gaurav Malhotra says that getting bail does not mean the end of the sentence. Azam Khan has been convicted in a total of 8 cases. In such a situation, to contest elections, he will first have to obtain a stay from a higher court against these convictions. Then what is the political meaning of Shivpal's meeting with Azam? Shivpal Yadav had met Azam and Abdullah in Rampur Jail on August 12. After this, he openly made statements regarding Azam's role. On August 13, Shivpal went even further and said that if the SP government is formed in 2027, Azam Khan will be made the Home Minister. It is not yet decided regarding Azam when he will get bail. Then, when will he get a stay on the sentence he received from the court? In such a situation, what are the political implications of Shivpal's statements? Political expert Rajendra Kumar explains this, saying - Muslim votes are very important for SP in 2027. Even though many Muslim faces, including Naseemuddin Siddiqui, are visible in SP, there is not a single leader of Azam's stature. Even while in jail, Azam has the ability to influence Muslim politics in Western UP. Shivpal's statement is a message to his supporters that SP stands with Azam. Now know in how many cases Azam was sentenced

stories.title: Heavy rain lashes Lucknow and 4 other cities, roads waterlogged:Alert in all 75 UP districts; bridge linking UP-MP submerged in Chitrakoot
stories.summary: There is a rain alert in all 75 districts of UP today. Since 5:30 AM on Sunday, rain has been occurring in 10 districts including Lucknow and Barabanki. Dark clouds are overcast. Meanwhile, Lucknow and surrounding districts received rain on Saturday. In Sambhal, the roof of a house collapsed due to rain. 7 members of the family were trapped under the debris. Due to rain, rivers are in spate. 11 rivers, including Ganga, Yamuna, and Sharda, have crossed the warning level. The water level of the Mandakini river in Chitrakoot has started rising. Water has reached colonies and homes. The steps of Ramghat are submerged. The water of Mandakini is flowing over the Arogyadham bridge built next to the river. In Unnao, Ganga water has entered homes. People are forced to live on rooftops. Boats are plying in the streets. Monsoon will remain active in UP for 3 days. More than 100 small temples built along the ghats in Varanasi have been submerged. The cremation ground at Harishchandra Ghat has been submerged. In the last 24 hours, Chitrakoot received the highest rainfall of 41.5 mm in the state, while 35.6 mm of rain was recorded in Hamirpur. See pictures of rain and flood According to Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh - The low-pressure area formed in the northwest Bay of Bengal is moving towards the west. It is passing through the regions of Jharkhand and North Chhattisgarh. As it moves forward, it is weakening. However, due to its influence, the monsoon will strengthen once again in North India. Its widespread impact can also be seen in Uttar Pradesh. Heavy rainfall is possible.

stories.title: BSP set to lose all four house representations after 37-years:Sole MLA dies; Rajya Sabha MP's term also ends in November
stories.summary: The Bahujan Samaj Party will become 'zero' in all four houses 37 years after its establishment. Its sole MLA Umashankar Singh passed away on August 5 in the UP Assembly. Like the national party Congress, BSP also has no member left in the UP Legislative Council. After the term of the party's sole Member of Legislative Council (MLC) Bhimrao Ambedkar ended in 2024, BSP could not return to the upper house. The party did not even open its account in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. Now, Ramji Gautam is the only MP in the Rajya Sabha. His term is also ending on November 25, 2026. This means that after this, BSP will have no member left in any of the four houses. First, know how BSP ended in the Assembly Kanshi Ram founded the BSP on April 14, 1984. In the 1984 Lok Sabha elections, BSP did not get an election symbol. Thus, its candidates contested as independents. Mayawati, from Kairana, secured more than 44 thousand votes, finishing third. Not a single candidate won. In 1987, BSP was allotted the elephant election symbol. In 1989, for the first time, 13 BSP MLAs won. In 2007, the party was at its peak, when it came to power alone in UP with 206 seats. The 2022 election proved to be the worst for BSP. Only one MLA could win. Currently, BSP has 2 MLAs across the country. Satish Kumar Yadav, who won from Ramgarh seat in Bihar, and Dr. Nachhattar Pal from Nawanshahr in Punjab are MLAs. Now know about BSP's fluctuating journey in the Lok Sabha In 1989, 3 MPs from UP and 1 from Punjab also won and reached the Lok Sabha. Similarly, in 2009, its highest number of 21 MPs won and reached the Lok Sabha. Of these, 20 won from UP and 1 from Madhya Pradesh. This was BSP's best performance. In the 2014 Lok Sabha elections, BSP was reduced to zero seats in the Modi wave. In 2019, BSP and SP contested the elections in an alliance, which benefited BSP. Their 10 MPs reached the Lok Sabha. However, in 2024, BSP, contesting alone, again reached a score of zero. Also know the situation in Rajya Sabha BSP's most glorious period in the Rajya Sabha was between 2010 and 2012. After forming a full majority government in UP in 2007, the number of BSP MPs reached 18 through the elections held in 2010. This was its highest level ever in the Upper House in the party's history. The party's sole Rajya Sabha MP, Ramji Gautam, was sent by the SP from its quota due to an alliance with the BSP. Currently, the BSP does not have a single MLA in the UP Assembly. Whereas, at least 10 MLAs are required for a proposer and a supporter for a Rajya Sabha candidate. 3 Reasons for BSP's Weakness- Prominent faces distanced themselves from BSP Currently, BSP is going through its worst phase. All its prominent faces have been sidelined from the party one by one. A few days ago, Mayawati expelled Ashok Siddharth, father-in-law of her nephew Akash Anand, and National Coordinator Randhir Singh Beniwal, accusing them of anti-party activities. Recently, Mayawati also expelled Anant Kumar Mishra alias Antu Mishra, who was counted among the Brahmin faces, from the party. Before this, prominent faces from the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) who were considered extremely backward, such as Daddu Prasad, RK Chaudhary, Raj Bahadur, Masood Ahmed, Barkhuram Verma, Sonelal Patel, Dinanath Bhaskar, Babu Singh Kushwaha, Sukhdev Rajbhar, Swami Prasad Maurya, Ramachal Rajbhar, Omprakash Rajbhar, Lalji Verma, and Ramprasad Chaudhary, have also distanced themselves from the party. Similarly, minority and Brahmin faces including Jaiveer Singh, Naseemuddin Siddiqui, Ramveer Upadhyay, and Brajesh Pathak have also moved away from the party. Due to these figures distancing themselves, the BSP's vote bank continued to weaken. Status of a national party is also in crisis The biggest crisis facing the BSP now is to save its national party status. The BSP could only secure 2.04% of the votes in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. No MP won across the country, but there are 2 MLAs in the country. Satish Kumar Yadav from Ramgarh seat in Bihar and Dr. Nachhattar Pal from Nawanshahr in Punjab are BSP MLAs. However, the criterion of being recognized as a regional party in 4 or more states also remains a challenge for it. The assembly elections in UP, Punjab, and Uttarakhand in 2027 are an opportunity for the BSP. If its performance improves in these states, it will save its national party status.

stories.title: Snakebite survivor kept awake with 150 slaps from brother:Hardoi youth monitored for an hour; doctors administer 15 injections to save him
stories.summary: A young man was bitten by a snake in Hardoi. His elder brother gave him a lift and took him to the hospital. Seeing the serious condition of the young man, the doctor advised that he should not be allowed to sleep at any cost. After this, the young man's elder brother continuously slapped him more than 150 times on his cheek so that he wouldn't fall asleep. The elder brother did not let the young man sleep for one hour. Doctors gave the young man 15 anti-venom injections, after which his life could be saved. Generally, a patient can be saved with just 5 anti-venom doses. The incident took place on Saturday at 2 PM in the Dehat Kotwali area. Details of the incident Snake bites as soon as grass sack is lifted Guddu (46) and his family live in Jyoti Nagar. The family includes his wife Neelam (43), two sons Akash and Arun, and a daughter Sanjana. The elder son Akash runs a dairy. On Saturday afternoon, he was working in the field. Around 2 PM, his younger brother Arun (21) went to the field with water for him. While working in the field, Arun lifted a sack of grass, and a snake hidden inside bit him. As soon as the snake bit him, Arun screamed. Hearing his brother's scream, Akash immediately rushed him towards the road. He called an ambulance and the police. Arun's condition began to deteriorate rapidly. Just then, Shivam Sharma, a medical store owner from Pragati Nagar, was passing by on the road. When Shivam saw Arun's critical condition, he put both brothers on his bike and took them to the medical college without delay. Elder brother slapped him more than 150 times on the cheek As soon as they reached the medical college, Emergency Medical Officer (EMO) Dr. Sher Singh and his five-member team immediately started treatment. The doctor strictly instructed the family members not to let the patient sleep at any cost. After this, the elder brother Akash continuously slapped Arun more than 150 times on his cheek to keep him conscious, so that he would remain awake and his condition could be monitored. Meanwhile, the hospital staff also kept trying to wake him up. According to Dr. Sher Singh, usually 5 injections are given for a snake bite, but the poison had spread quite a lot in Arun's body. He was given a total of 15 anti-venom injections within 2 hours. The doctor said that falling asleep after a snake bite can be fatal for the patient, as it carries the risk of the nervous system shutting down and vomit getting stuck in the windpipe. However, Arun's condition is now normal and the team of doctors is keeping an eye on him.

stories.title: Pooja Pal says Atiq’s family is responsible for mass killings:‘Criminality is ingrained in their mindset; they can never reform’
stories.summary: UP BJP Vice President Pooja Pal has given a big statement regarding the sons of mafia Atiq Ahmed. She said, “Those who have mischief in their blood, who are tormentors, land grabbers, mass murderers, their thinking can never change. If Atiq had to change, he would have changed by now. He would have given good values to his children. I say that whether they remain in jail or come out of jail, their thinking can never change.” Pooja Pal expressed displeasure over many leaders, including MLA Pallavi Patel, going to Atiq's family to express grief over Aban's death. Now read what Pooja Pal said Pooja Pal said, “It is difficult to believe that such people will improve after going to jail or going through difficult circumstances. Those whose mindset inherently involves crime and causing pain to others can never change.” Some people believe that a person changes after being in jail or after major life events, but I do not agree with this. Those who have mischief in their blood, whose mindset is to cause pain to people, grab land, commit mass murder, and exploit, whether they are in jail or outside, their mentality cannot change. Atiq's family members can never improve Pooja Pal further said that Atiq Ahmed's family is already facing many difficulties and disintegration. Despite this, no change is visible in their behavior and thinking. These are the people of Atiq Ahmed's family, they can never improve. Pooja Pal said that in times of sorrow, people should show simplicity and restraint, but the behavior of the family members does not suggest that they have learned any lesson. She alleged that their mindset is still the same as it was before. Their mindset has always been one of mischief and mafia-like tendencies. Whether it's the father or the son, it makes no difference to them. This is why no change is seen in their working style and attitude. Now know about Pooja Pal Pooja Pal is the wife of the late MLA Raju Pal. Raju Pal was an MLA from the Allahabad West assembly constituency. MLA Pooja Pal, who was expelled from the SP, was recently made the state vice-president by the BJP. Pooja Pal's story in UP politics has been full of tragedy and struggle. She became a widow just 9 days after her marriage. She had to enter politics against her will. She fought her first election against her husband's killer, but lost. Despite that, Pooja showed courage and fought. She won the next election. She fought a legal battle against the most powerful person in Prayagraj. Amidst all this, many changes came in her political life. Pooja changed parties. She became an MLA from SP. On the night of April 15, 2023, around 10:30 PM, Atiq Ahmed and his brother Ashraf were murdered. After that day, Pooja's mind changed. She distanced herself from SP and was seen standing with BJP. On August 14, 2025, Akhilesh Yadav also expelled Pooja Pal from SP. After this, she joined BJP. Read, how Atiq's son Aban died Aban was traveling from Prayagraj to Jhansi on Thursday (August 6) morning. He had 4 other friends in the Creta car. Aban was sitting in the front seat of the car. His friend Zaid was driving the car, while Sonu was sitting behind Aban. The car, traveling at a speed of 120 km/h, hit the divider on the side where Aban was sitting. This was why he sustained the most injuries. Aban and Sonu died on the spot shortly after the collision. According to the post-mortem report, Aban's liver, lungs, and spleen ruptured due to the severe collision. His ribs were also broken. He died due to excessive internal bleeding. His friend Sonu, who was sitting behind Aban's seat in the car, died due to a fractured skull. Buried next to father Atiq's grave On August 8, Aban was buried in Prayagraj next to his father Atiq's grave. His three brothers, Ali, Umar, and Ahjam, carried Aban's bier. Mother Shaista Parveen did not attend her son's funeral. She had also not attended the funerals of her husband Atiq and son Asad. Shaista has been absconding since 2023. Ali and Umar were granted parole by the Allahabad High Court after 4 years to attend their brother's funeral. Following this, the police brought Ali from Jhansi and Umar from Lucknow. Curtains were drawn on the van so that their faces would not be visible.
